tess: Quick flag   ~47 backup objects in s3://tenant-backups-prod uploaded w/ SSE-S3 instead of SSE-KMS at ~01:05 UTC. Saw via monitoring rule.

omar: Can you paste the object sample keys?

tess: sample: tenant42/snapshots/2026-07-11-0105.tar.gz, tenant99/snapshots/2026-07-11-0106.tar.gz

devops-bot: Alert INV-2026-07-11-001: S3 objects missing aws:kms encryption (count=47).

omar: I'll grep CloudTrail for PutObject and see the principal.

compliance: If these are tenant snapshots we need to start customer impact matrix. Any restores since then?

tess: Not that I can see. No GetObject calls for those keys in the window.

omar: CloudTrail shows assumed-role:backup-worker-2026 made the puts. That role was updated in terraform 2 hours before deploy; policy diff removed kms:Encrypt by accident.

tess: OK pause cron on backup workers. Also add temporary bucket policy deny for non-kms PutObject (apply to prod only after testing).

omar: Short remediation plan: 1) re-add kms:Encrypt to role, 2) run pilot re-encrypt for 10 objects using s3 cp with --metadata-directive REPLACE and aws:kms, 3) run restore test, 4) scale.

compliance: Prepare customer notification draft but hold until we confirm if any PII in snapshots. I'll check retention tags and scanning metadata.

tess: For re-encrypt example CLI: `aws s3 cp s3://tenant-backups-prod/tenant42/snapshots/2026-07-11-0105.tar.gz s3://tenant-backups-prod/tenant42/snapshots/2026-07-11-0105.tar.gz --metadata-directive REPLACE --server-side-encryption aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/ef01-2345`

omar: Throttle workers to 5 concurrent to avoid KMS quota issues. Watch CloudWatch KMSThrottles and S3 PutRequests.

tess: I'll open INC-2044 and assign. Tagging @compliance for the notification.

devops-bot: INC-2044 created. Assigned: omar, tess. ETA pilot: 30m.
